100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 29, 1926, the world faced a tumultuous backdrop as the League of Nations convened in Geneva, seeking resolutions to ongoing tensions following the Great War. In the United States, the film industry buzzed with the release of new silent films, as Hollywood continued to dominate popular culture. Meanwhile, in Europe, political instability simmered, with rising concerns over the impact of economic hardships in Germany.
